title: Truman meeting and the secret Anderson Trust

tellings.quote: They're going to set up this secret uh uh trust they call the Anderson Trust. They set it up down in Houston, Texas.

plain: A lawyer named Dan Sheehan says that after a meeting with President Harry Truman in 1945, officials set up a secret fund called the Anderson Trust, based in Houston, Texas. Telling it on Michels's show without naming his source, Sheehan ties the story to figures such as General Douglas MacArthur, War Secretary Henry Stimson, the intelligence officer Ed Lansdale, the presidential adviser Clark Clifford and a man named Robert Anderson. If true, it would mean the secret was managed through a private trust outside normal government oversight.
